templates.title: MORTIS FIELD NETWORK
templates.body:
You have reached the Mortis Field Network.

This surface carries notices, briefings, and working channels. It is not the record of what happened and it is not the place that verifies it.

What you witness is the world.
What you can verify is your terminal.
What you hear here is traffic.

Read CONDUCT AND TERMS. Accept them. Then complete intake.

Restricted does not mean false. It means you do not currently need it.

templates.title: CONDUCT AND TERMS
templates.body:
Plain language.

1. You are responsible for what you post. Do not publish other people's private information, real-world addresses, or anything that would get someone hurt in or out of play.
2. Consent is required for lasting harm to a character: injury, death, captivity, memory change, possession, romance, or identity-level outcomes. Pause out of character when those are on the table.
3. Staff can remove content and restrict access. Appeals exist. Use SUPPORT DESK.
4. This Discord does not decide what is true in the world. Do not treat a channel as an archive of record.
5. World-content proposals are not taken here. If you have material to offer, a staff member will point you at the inbox the operators already use.
6. You must meet Discord's terms of service. You may be asked for a minimum account age.

Flavored framing.

Secure dangerous tools. Stay inside clearance. Stop when told. Report what changes. Protect people. Do not use secrecy or authority to pressure others.

Press Accept to record that you have read this. Intake will not complete without it.

templates.title: INTAKE
templates.body:
Intake is processing, not a story.

You will: confirm you accepted CONDUCT AND TERMS, give a callsign for this network, and receive the Initiate presentation mark.

There is no lore dump. There is no progress track. Locked names you can see are names, not invitations to guess.

Press Begin Intake.

templates.title: HOW TO BEGIN
templates.body:
You arrived somewhere that was already running.

1. Read CONDUCT AND TERMS. Press Accept.
2. Go to ENTRY. Press Begin Intake. Give a callsign.
3. After intake, NETWORK and FIELD channels open. Locked names you can see are names, not invitations.
4. Notices and briefings appear in NOTICES. Technical status is NETWORK STATUS.
5. Need help? SUPPORT DESK. Tickets are private. Categories: general, report, appeal, accessibility.
6. What you witness is the world. What you can verify is your terminal. What you hear here is traffic.
7. If you miss a notice, it is still a notice — not a secret test. Ask in QUESTIONS or open a ticket.

Restricted does not mean false. It means you do not currently need it.

templates.title: SUPPORT DESK
templates.body:
If you need help, open a ticket.

Categories: general, report, appeal, accessibility.

Reports and appeals are visible only to OWNER and OPERATIONS.

A person asking for help does not owe anyone a story.

templates.title: WORLD ACCESS
templates.body:
World-join information is posted here when issued.

What you witness is the world.
What you can verify is your terminal.
What you hear here is traffic.

Discord does not adjudicate what you witnessed. If nothing is posted, wait for a notice.

templates.title: REFERENCE
templates.body:
Functional answers. This is not an archive of record.

How do I get started?
HOW TO BEGIN in ARRIVAL. Accept terms, then intake.

What should I do first?
Read CONDUCT AND TERMS. Complete ENTRY. Then watch NOTICES.

How does communication work?
OPEN CHANNEL is in-character traffic. QUESTIONS is out-of-character and clear. NOTICES are posted, not debated.

What are the basic conduct rules?
CONDUCT AND TERMS. Consent for lasting harm to a character. Do not publish private real-world information. Staff can remove content. Appeals exist.

How do tickets work?
SUPPORT DESK → Open ticket. Private channel. Report and appeal tickets go only to OWNER and OPERATIONS.

How do I get help?
SUPPORT DESK, or QUESTIONS for non-private asks.

Where do I find approved information?
Your terminal / Internal Network verifies. RECORDS only re-presents published player-safe material. Discord does not decide what is true.

What happens if I miss something?
Nothing here is a hidden exam. Ask. Open a ticket if it is private.

How do Discord, the world, and the terminal relate?
Witness the world. Verify on the terminal. Hear traffic here.

What do I do if something goes wrong?
SUPPORT DESK. If arrival is closed, wait for a further notice.

World-content proposals are not taken in tickets. Staff will point you at the operators' inbox.

templates.title: NOT A CANON STORE
templates.body:
This channel is not a canon store.
World-content proposals go to MORTIS_ADMIN_INBOX on Drive, owner-initiated import only.
Do not paste unpublished material into Discord.
Nothing here is player-visible unless it later passes dispatch.

templates.title: MAINTENANCE
templates.body:
The Field Network will be under maintenance {window}.
Expect interrupted channels. This is a technical notice, not a story event.

templates.title: OUTAGE
DEPLOYMENT STATUS
templates.body:
A technical deployment is {status}.
No world content is released by this notice.

templates.title: APPLICATION UPDATE
templates.body:
Your terminal has an update available: {presentation_name}.
Published at {published_at}.
Verify it on the Internal Network / your terminal. Discord is not the record.

templates.title: LOCKDOWN
templates.body:
Arrival is closed and invites are paused.
This is a safety action. Wait for a further notice.

templates.title: INTAKE AVAILABILITY
templates.body:
Intake processing is {status}.
This is a technical notice. It does not change world content.
